standard_prerequisites.name: Injectivity on conormal level
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives that I/mI -> J/mJ is injective, which splits the minimal generators.

standard_prerequisites.name: Regularity of minimal generating systems
standard_prerequisites.use: Any minimal system of generators of J is a regular sequence; independence transfers to the initial segment and to the images in A/I.

core_obligations: Injectivity yields s <= r and a minimal system f_1, ..., f_r of J whose first s elements lie in I and minimally generate I.
Conclude: f_1, ..., f_s form a regular sequence in A (initial segment of a regular sequence), and the images of f_{s+1}, ..., f_r generate J/I as a regular sequence.
proof_roadmap: Run the splitting argument and apply the two named regularity lemmas.
difficulty_reason: Short splitting argument over named transfer lemmas; the bookkeeping of minimal generators is the content.
